'''November 2000 All American Collectibles tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in All-American Collectibles, metro St. Louis on 18 November 2000. [[Dustin Horn]] won it. It is known from Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1473">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-the-short-report-from-norm-11-18-00-aacd1473/ the-short-report-from-norm-11-18-00-aac], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 19 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-19-the-short-report-from-norm-11-18-00-aacd1473/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2000
* '''Site:''' All-American Collectibles, metro St. Louis
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Dustin Horn]]
